properties.description: Daily ETL: pull groundwater, rainfall and surface-water data from the public APIs and load Azure SQL. Anomaly detection runs separately on the Function's daily 06:00 UTC timer (one hour after this 05:00 UTC load). RunIngestion executes on the referenced Azure Batch pool (ls_batch), staging its resource files in ls_staging; provide a Batch account/pool before running.

activities.name: RunIngestion
activities.description: Runs the Python ingestion package. As a Custom activity this executes on an Azure Batch pool; swap to a Container Apps Job or Web Activity if no Batch pool is available. Collects all sources and upserts them into Azure SQL.

activities.name: LogIngestionFailure
activities.description: Records a row in an audit table if ingestion fails, supporting data-integrity reporting.
